general_principles: PLACEHOLDER playbook for the NDA contract type. This is an unbound 'coming soon' stub: it is registered in the catalog so the contract-type picker can surface NDA as a not-yet-active dial stop, but it carries no active release bundle and governs no production review. Content below is illustrative placeholder text only.
Default toward ACCEPT for anything that does not touch a floor protection this placeholder relies on.
Every change is either ACCEPT or REQUEST_CHANGE with specific replacement text. Never 'flag for review'.

accept_when: Change is clerical, stylistic, or grammatical without legal impact.
Change updates the counterparty's own legal name, address, contact info, or signatory.
request_change_when: Change matches an entry on the hard_rejections list.
Change introduces an obligation not contemplated by this placeholder playbook.

topics.our_standard: Placeholder position: confidentiality obligations are mutual and survive termination for a defined, bounded period, with the usual carve-outs (already known, independently developed, publicly available, or compelled by law).
reject_if_proposed: a perpetual, uncapped confidentiality obligation with no carve-outs

hard_rejections.description: Placeholder floor: counterparty introduces a perpetual, unbounded confidentiality obligation with no carve-outs.

de_minimis_categories: Counterparty's own legal name, address, email, or signatory updates.

footnote_phrasing_rules: One or two sentences per footnote. No more.
Name the specific risk created rather than generic phrases like 'not standard'.
Plain English. Avoid legalese where a plain word does the job.

system_status.manual_review_routing: Manual-review states are operational statuses and never external legal decisions.
